title: Communication hub, filtered history and delivery overview
permissions: read capability; current church from session; SQL scoped to church.
states: History supports email/sms/both and draft/scheduled/sending/sent/failed/logged stored values; aggregate includes sent messages, attempted/delivered/opened/clicked/bounced/failed recipient counts.
validation: URL page/limit positive; limit max100; invalid enum/search falls back; search is subject/body case-insensitive substring; distinct available filters reflect all history.
failures: Rates must distinguish attempted versus all selected people; zero denominator yields safe display. Runtime read failure is page error, not a fake empty history. Subject display re-merges current linked meeting facts, unlike delivery-time frozen church fields.
decision: Preserve capability; implementation redesign is proposed, no removal approved.

title: Message detail, recipient and person/meeting communication histories
permissions: read; recipient detail SQL church-scoped, subject parent is church-scoped.
states: Per-message stats and per-person status timestamps; across messages the best outcome display wins, distinct from lifecycle precedence.
validation: Message/person/meeting identifiers must belong to caller church; gone parent is not found.
failures: Historical email snapshot versus current person email must be clearly labelled. getMeetingCommunications child query trusts the previously church-scoped communication-id set; v3 should enforce tenant predicates consistently.
decision: Preserve capability; implementation redesign is proposed, no removal approved.

title: Compose and preview sanitized rich-text email with merge fields
permissions: communication.send; session actor/church; no recipient outside church is loaded.
states: Creates sending then sent or failed; recipient pending then provider outcome. UI forces email; protocol schema still admits sms/both.
validation: Subject1..500 chars, nonempty body, optional UUID template/meeting, >=1 UUID recipient; HTML sanitized before storing; plain text derives from same safe HTML; person/church/meeting merge contexts; preview uses same rendering functions.
failures: JSON.parse of recipientIds happens before schema/try and can throw; schema accepts arbitrary nonempty body and sms/both despite email-only implementation; cross-church meeting lookup can leave unresolved fields while original meetingId is inserted. No idempotency guard for repeated send. Missing emails skip delivery but recipientCount counts selected persons.
decision: Preserve email compose/preview/merge semantics. Freeze delivered content and explicit resolved metadata. SMS/both is an open capability decision, not assumed supported or approved for removal.

title: Recipient search and closed quick-select groups
permissions: read; same church; deleted people excluded from groups; active team memberships only.
states: core_group/launch_team/leaders/prospects/all and team:<UUID>; forming/active teams offered, paused omitted; one person with multiple team roles deduplicated.
validation: Unknown selector resolves nobody, never all. Recruitment cohorts omit account-seat person rows; all is full people list. Search first20; group resolution whole list avoids pagination truncation.
failures: Search result includes people without email; group empty is explicit zero recipients. Submission must re-resolve recipients and reachability, preventing stale audience or undeleted assumptions.
decision: Preserve capability; implementation redesign is proposed, no removal approved.

title: Bulk provider dispatch and per-recipient outcome correlation
permissions: communication.send; minted recipient UUID ties each payload to storage.
states: Main finishes sent after provider error/exception in several cases; alpha final status sent only if acceptedCount>0, else failed. Partially accepted batch becomes sent; per-recipient failures remain visible.
validation: Render independent payloads in parallel, batch max100, provider results matched to request chunk positions rather than INSERT RETURNING order.
failures: Bulk path calls raw Resend and omits shared sendEmail suppression, reply-to, unsubscribe, provider idempotency and retry policy. Render/token failures before provider try may leave sending row. Short provider-result array can leave pending recipients. Unknown send outcome needs reconciliation, not unconditional resend.
decision: Preserve main bulk flow plus alpha truthful failure behavior. Replace private send loop with common transport plus durable per-send/per-recipient attempt records, while distinguishing subscription preferences from transactional/bulk consent.

title: Alpha provider rejection is surfaced to composer
permissions: Same communication.send boundary as main.
states: Zero accepted => failed, sentAt null; provider exceptions fail still-pending recipients; normal composer returns error with communicationId for details.
validation: No valid recipients rejects; no reachable emails becomes failed.
failures: resendToNonOpenersAction still returns success even when new communication result is failed. Need acceptance for both send and resend, mixed success, missing ID, partial batch and network exception.
decision: Carry alpha correction into full v3 parity; status of unmerged source is local-only, not main.

title: System and church message-template CRUD and copy-on-write forks
permissions: read for browse; communication.send for create/update/delete/fork. Global system rows plus current church; foreign custom edit/delete refused; system delete refused.
states: One fork per(church,source_template) enforced partial unique index; fork hides original; delete fork re-exposes original.
validation: Name trimmed1..255; description<=1000; subject<=500; rich body nonempty; create action email-only, update accepts other channels; content stored sanitized HTML and flat text.
failures: Nullable church+source gap and absent FK sourceTemplateId deserve stronger v3 checks; main getSystemTemplates only isSystem without global predicate, unlike getTemplates. Deleting a template referenced by communications can FK-fail; no archive surface. Concurrent fork safe via upsert, concurrent patches last-writer wins.
decision: Preserve capability; implementation redesign is proposed, no removal approved.

title: Canonical message-template bootstrap and meeting invitation selection
permissions: Reference-content operator bootstrap, not arbitrary customer writer; meeting selection scoped.
states: Template categories meeting_invitation/meeting_reminder/follow_up/core_group/team/announcement/launch/other; selection prefers church fork by source identity.
validation: Merge field catalog and canonical snippets; templates seeded by name/system identity, updates overwrite reference content; script runs immediately on invocation. Main repository catalog has seven entries including one invitation per current meeting type; canonical snapshot has seven system template rows.
failures: Current seed read-then-update/insert is not concurrent-safe and uses names as identity; no explicit content version/source approval stamp. v3 content bootstrap must be immutable/versioned and idempotent using stable IDs, respecting church customizations.
decision: Preserve capability; implementation redesign is proposed, no removal approved.

title: Reviewed resend to delivered non-openers
permissions: communication.send, current church, server repeats gate.
states: Only sent original, >=24h elapsed, >=1 confirmed delivery and remaining deliverable person IDs; new communication/history entry, original unchanged.
validation: Provider open or click excludes; missing/deleted email audience is excluded; resolved audience count is shown before confirm; legacy plant tokens cleared rather than falsely acquiring current pastor/date.
failures: Open tracking is not reliable evidence of attention; gate reduces repeat storm but repeated approved request lacks dedupe; on retries body meeting/person facts can change. Preserve delivered content snapshot and batch membership for review.
decision: Preserve capability; implementation redesign is proposed, no removal approved.

source_wrapper_aliases.role: source controller wrapper/side-effect chain; not a required public v3 API

title: Public token RSVP and email engagement linkage
permissions: Possession of random expiring token authorizes its exact meeting/person, no session required; own authenticated RSVP separate in meeting module.
states: pending=>confirmed/declined; one pending pair via partial unique; expired pending renewed in place; answered token history remains; resolved recipient engagement elevated to clicked.
validation: Default7 days; bounded race reread; CAS token answer and canonical meeting_response transaction/statement; expiry checked atomically.
failures: GET never silently records answer; scanner-safe explicit confirm/decline action; tokens are sensitive. Native deletion expiry/bad token yields clear refusal. Distinguish RSVP response from attendance or commitment and record explicit source.
decision: Preserve capability; implementation redesign is proposed, no removal approved.

title: Person contact log derived from completed person-linked task
permissions: Uses task event actor/church; verifies related person in same church and not deleted.
states: Terminal logged, recipient logical record, sentAt means contact occurrence; externalId task:<taskId>; never provider send.
validation: Only person-linked completed task; repeated event normally ignored by read guard.
failures: Replay read guard is not concurrent uniqueness; main single-task completion race can duplicate entries. Completion does not prove outreach actually occurred. V3 should preserve record as completed follow-up assertion with explicit provenance/undo correction, not infer email sent.
decision: Preserve capability; implementation redesign is proposed, no removal approved.

title: Declared drafts, scheduled sends, SMS and inbound capabilities
permissions: No current draft/schedule/SMS/inbound mutation or scheduler located in current source.
states: Enums permit draft/scheduled/sms/both; UI sends email immediately.
validation: Stored values shown in history; direct schema input can incorrectly label email dispatch as SMS.
failures: Do not invent shipped scheduler or Twilio integration from FRD labels, enum values or installed skills.
decision: Explicit product decision on historical intended scope; preserve current read compatibility in inventory. No feature removal assumed approved.

title: Tenant/organization anchored enqueue and deduplicated delivery intent
permissions: Recipient relationship rechecked; only eligible audience/category/anchor combinations admitted; oversight disallows granular categories.
states: pending/claimed/delivered/cancelled/failed; cancelled rows release dedupe slot; church versus sending_church/network anchor exclusive.
validation: Strict schema UUIDs, title clamp255, type/dedupe lengths, paired entity discriminator/id; partial unique church+recipient+key and org+recipient+key for live rows.
failures: Org anchor UUID is generalized without FK; coherent anchor constraints retained, opaque organization union needs typed service contract. Refusal outside-church/privacy creates no row and must be measurable.
decision: Preserve capability; implementation redesign is proposed, no removal approved.

title: Atomic channel dispatcher, batching, backoff and live-subject cancellation
permissions: CRON_SECRET constant-time bearer; delivery rechecks recipient relationship, prefs, liveness and sharing; registered task/meeting predicates in cron runtime.
states: Atomic pending claim SKIP LOCKED; one delivery per(notification,channel); 3 attempts,5m exponential max1h; permanent failure never retried; unresolved live check releases claim; group(anchor,recipient,category).
validation: Max100 rows,45s budget; unprocessed claims returned pending; provider idempotency key based on owned notification/attempt set; HTML/text composer errors settle retryable failures.
failures: Crash leaves queued channel/claimed notification without automatic reclaim to avoid duplicate mail; DB unique delivery does not prove external at-most-once across crash. v3 requires lease recovery plus provider key/outcome reconciliation and operator uncertain-state flow.
decision: Preserve capability; implementation redesign is proposed, no removal approved.

title: In-app notification feed, unread filters, pagination and bell
permissions: Viewer scope derived from session; self.write to mark own rows; read to load; oversight/current coach relationship filters.
states: Pending due and delivered rows visible under eligibility predicates; future/cancelled/denied rows omitted; readAt independent of delivery status; keyset cursor(createdAt,id).
validation: UUID mark ID; valid datetime/UUID cursor; unreadOnly boolean; stable cursor and current preference/category restrictions; mark-all uses same visibility boundary as displayed feed.
failures: Stale relationships/sharing removed from read feeds, already emailed messages cannot be recalled. Hidden count must not reveal unauthorized rows. Empty result and failed load are distinct UI outcomes.
decision: Preserve capability; implementation redesign is proposed, no removal approved.

title: User category/channel preferences with explicit-choice intent
permissions: self.write; owner from session, never request; oversight categories limited to milestones/digest; oversight daily cadence not user-editable.
states: Absence inherits coded default; chosen persists human consent even at default value; incidental cadence-save value inherits if equal default; planter daily/weekly digest defaultweekly.
validation: Closed7 categories and2 channels; code defaults mostly true, digest in_app false for church and true for oversight; no-op checks avoid stale incidental writes.
failures: Simplify UI policy, retain distinction between inherited/default and explicit user choice. Settings matrix must not offer inert teams/phase/communication producers as if implemented.
decision: Preserve capability; implementation redesign is proposed, no removal approved.

title: Task due/overdue reminders and reminder cancellation/resync
permissions: Assignee is recipient where applicable; same church/active seat/relationship; domain writes own reminder facts.
states: task.due/task.overdue intents; due-date/id dedupe; complete/delete/reassign/reschedule cancel stale intents and regenerate applicable ones; alpha follows revised assignee/follow-up ownership. Due reminder at due instant and overdue reminder after one calendar-day offset.
validation: Task eligibility/liveness reloaded before dispatch; overdue threshold derives actual current task not old body.
failures: Best-effort reminder side effects can lag source operation; retryable cancellation/enqueue failures must be observable and repairable without rolling back a legitimate task edit.
decision: Preserve capability; implementation redesign is proposed, no removal approved.

title: Meeting scheduled and day-offset reminders
permissions: Meeting audience by type; only linked authenticated users receive notifications; guest bulk invitation is separate communication pipeline.
states: Immediate scheduled announcement to linked core-group accounts; reminders at seven/three/one days before meeting to guest-list linked accounts plus meeting creator; edits cancel and rebuild reminders; cancelled/completed/past meeting liveness suppresses stale reminder.
validation: Meeting date/type/location metadata; church-local interpretation at construction and dispatch; association changes re-evaluated. The guest-list audience is sourced from meeting_attendance joined to persons and users; meeting_guests is not a source-defined table. Church/person login guards are applied to that audience.
failures: No-email/ineligible account must not cause mailing an unrelated CRM address. Registered predicates are essential in actual cron process, not merely test process.
decision: Preserve capability; implementation redesign is proposed, no removal approved.

title: Planter open-items daily/weekly digest and church local send schedule
permissions: User cadence + preference; church.profile changes church weekday/hour/timezone; scoped assignee/task visibility.
states: Only nonempty overdue/due-before-next-digest/upcoming-meeting counts; daily or weekly period key dedupes; defaultSunday16:00 church-local.
validation: Calendar/DST-aware periods; 25 plants/page,500 ceiling,10s sweep budget; query selects owed cohorts rather than truncating and starving tail.
failures: Missed ticks delay current period delivery; no replay of every missed historical digest. Alpha task ownership semantics must be reflected, not old globally assigned task count.
decision: Preserve capability; implementation redesign is proposed, no removal approved.

title: Oversight privacy-preserving daily activity digest
permissions: Oversight activity sharing required; active sending church/network admin reach only; misprovisioned multi-tenancy seats refused/reported; no granular recipient data.
states: Daily previous complete app-zone day; only nonzero counts for meetings/people/tasks/phase activity; per-plant/day/recipient dedupe; current relationship checked again at send/read.
validation: Counts only, no person names/notes/messages/giving; 25/page,500 ceiling,10s budget; per-org audience avoids tenancy collision.
failures: Current oversight uses app timezone while planter uses church zone; v3 should decide explicit daily window, preserve consent meaning. No hidden activity when sharing is off; already-sent email persists.
decision: Preserve capability; implementation redesign is proposed, no removal approved.

title: Relationship, sharing, phase and launch milestone fanout
permissions: milestones only; relationship facts can be exempt from sharing; phase/launch needs oversight activity sharing; departed relationship recipient handled deliberately.
states: Occurrence identity dedupes; phase only actual advance, not declaration/backward movement; plant owner also notified when org removes association.
validation: Known milestone vocabulary; explicit church/org anchor; privacy changed announces closure of sharing without listing private facts.
failures: Best-effort fanout failures must not invalidate association/phase operation; repair intent must capture event-time audience and policy without reopening private access.
decision: Preserve capability; implementation redesign is proposed, no removal approved.

title: Signed delivery webhooks for notifications and bulk communication
permissions: Raw request verified by Resend/Svix id/timestamp/signature; fail invalid signature400; provider ID exact lookup, no public tenancy input.
states: Notification failed event overwrites queued/sent channel only; soft bounce transient, hard/complaint permanent; communication sent/delivered/opened/clicked rank monotonic except bounce/fail terminal overrides.
validation: Unknown/missing message ID =>ack200; hard bounce complaint suppress every event.to address globally; delivery times use processing now, not created_at.
failures: Catch-all DB/processing failure responds200 and loses provider retry; no durable event ID inbox/dedup/order history; concurrent read/rank/update can regress status. Bulk bounce error unconditionally says hard even when soft. Notification parent state not necessarily reopened after asynchronous failed channel event.
decision: Preserve capability; implementation redesign is proposed, no removal approved.

title: Global address suppression and self-service restoration history
permissions: Session self.write can clear only current account email; generic clear helper also supports admin actor but no admin UI found.
states: One active suppression/address; clear retains historical row(reason/time/actor), repeat clear success false/no-op; subsequent hard bounce creates new row.
validation: Normalized trim/lowercase; only hard_bounce/spam_complaint; clearedAt/reason paired constraint; nonempty reason; dispatch loads batch suppressed set.
failures: UI copy says holder re-verified, but action requires only current session and does not require fresh verification/password. Decide stronger restoration proof. Current raw bulk sender ignores suppression and several direct transactional senders also bypass queue check.
decision: Preserve capability; implementation redesign is proposed, no removal approved.

title: Category email unsubscribe, one-click opt-out and bounded undo
permissions: Opaque AES256-GCM token binds user/category/purpose, no auth required; production dedicated secret>=32; dev may use CRON_SECRET fallback.
states: Disable token180days; distinct enable/undo token1hour; GET displays confirmation, POST mutates; in_app untouched; chosen intent records consent.
validation: Malformed/tampered/expired/wrong-purpose fail closed; no public token contents; RFC8058 List-Unsubscribe headers; unknown recipient refused.
failures: Endpoint POST always200 on invalid token for provider; UI distinguishes expired/refusal. Secret rotation invalidates in-flight tokens; key version/rotation plan needed. Unsubscribe does not govern bulk CRM recipient email consent today.
decision: Preserve capability; implementation redesign is proposed, no removal approved.

title: Shared transactional email transport and protected email templates
permissions: Domain issuer decides credential/recipient; actor/address/token never arbitrary Evry parameters; recovery/verification is auth module.
states: Provider acceptance wrapper returns success/id/error; true provider idempotency is request options, not RFC header; reply-to configurable everyfield.app identity.
validation: HTML/text pairs, token-safe server logging redaction; optional RFC headers and idempotency; email-change/recovery invalidation requirements in auth specs.
failures: No provider timeout in shared helper, no durable transport retry/history outside notification delivery; feedback and public invite use same helper. Current development successful-send logs include address and subject. Sensitive recovery links must remain out of logs/tool context.
decision: Preserve capability; implementation redesign is proposed, no removal approved.

title: Declared notification producers and unused email helpers

states: Template functions implemented; team.welcome/team.alert helpers have no runtime caller found. Phase advance oversight milestone is live separately.
validation: Do not count rendering helpers or category labels as sent product behavior.
failures: Historical FRD describes these producers; not current implementation proof. Scope decision needed, with full feature-preserving plan reservation rather than silent removal.
decision: Reserve explicit feature decision and acceptance gate for historical intended producers. Standalone unused helpers can be replaced once semantic behavior is specified.

title: Discovery association postcommit transactional receipts
permissions: Internal postcommit producer, not an authorization entry point. Caller owns winning association mutation and audit lifecycle. Receipt goes to the discovery account and only valid owners of the exact organization; admins are not included merely by being admins. Defective or multi-tenant principal links are excluded. Seatless discovery accounts require neither a church nor a notification row.
states: accepted/declined uses winning invitation ID as occurrence; left/removed uses committed association audit-event ID. Email sends after association persistence; each audience principal gets one rendered HTML/plain-text message and /dashboard or /oversight link. Result reports sent/failed counts.
validation: Recipient account must resolve to the requested user; organization and owner tenancy must match. Recipient Map keyed by user ID prevents overlap. Provider key hashes user, organization type/id, event, durable occurrence and recipient. Retrying the same winning event reuses the key; organization owners other than the affected discovery principal are resolved from current facts.
failures: Missing facts yields failed=1. Per-recipient render/provider refusal/transport exceptions increment failure without undoing committed association. Logs intentionally avoid recipient addresses/payload and exception details. Provider idempotency is bounded by provider retention; no durable notification delivery row, outbox or later receipt reconciliation exists. Shared direct sender does not apply notification preference/suppression handling automatically; keep transactional purpose distinct and unify safe transport policies explicitly.
decision: Preserve discovery association receipts and owner audience. Use one reviewed domain association operation plus reliable postcommit intent/transport where loss matters; no customer migration or second seat tenancy is required. Root identity/oversight specification owns association authority; this feature owns receipt production.

title: Document template library, filtering and contextual entry points

states: 11 templates,12 template/format combinations; categories commitment/vision_meeting/administrative/operational; optional phase and related Wiki slug.
validation: Unknown contextual catalog IDs dropped; exact curated article-to-template mapping; meeting-type and team checklist matching; valid template query deep link opens generate dialog.
failures: Missing retired catalog template should not create a broken download link; same renderer registry validates offered format. No user-uploaded/custom document template editing found.
decision: Preserve capability; implementation redesign is proposed, no removal approved.

title: Merge-value generation and exact-byte PDF/DOCX/XLSX previews

states: PDF inline bytes preview; DOCX parsed generated ZIP XML paragraphs/tables/footer and XLSX generated workbook sheets/cells/formulas preview JSON; preview never stored.
validation: Catalog fields only; user provided nonempty wins auto defaults; invalid/unsupported format falls back first offered. Auto church_name, current user_name as pastor_name, launch target date format; required field is UI descriptor and no server nonempty bound found.
failures: GET nonpreview has durable write side effect; arbitrarily long query merge values no server limit; source of pastor_name is current user not authoritative planter profile; preview8MB limit,XML2m chars,1000 blocks,XLSX20 sheets/500rows/50cols. Render failure500; preview content faithful but not full Word pagination.
decision: Preserve exact-byte preview/render single source. Use bounded typed POST for durable generation, distinct read-only preview and explicit authorization; agree pastor identity semantics instead of silently rewriting template content.

title: Saved generated-document history and fresh signed re-download

validation: UUID history ID strict; unique storageKey,format DB enum/check; storage path documents/<church>/<UUID>.<ext>; template name fallback for removed catalog entry.
failures: Cleanup failure logs but leaves orphan object; upload success/DB failure repair requires lifecycle reconciler. Download failure clear UI error. Stored row lacks merge-value/template-version/content checksum and initial actor ownership changes; no deletion/archive/retention UI.
decision: Preserve capability; implementation redesign is proposed, no removal approved.

title: Private storage service and uploaded commitment attachments

states: Private bucket; commitment documents signed download; replacement immutable object name; max10MB commitment upload.

No universal file-library/upload-any-file feature found. Commitment upload occurs before createCommitment and no compensation is visible in inspected action, so DB failure can leave unreferenced object.

decision: Preserve capability; implementation redesign is proposed, no removal approved.

title: Sessionless global Wiki crawler previews and authentication boundary
operations: sessionless bare layout for scoped Wiki preview
permissions: Known crawler User-Agent plus exact /wiki prefix is a public-preview allowance only. Actual session governs personal/church content and all writes. A spoofed known User-Agent can reach the global published Wiki shell; this is not trusted authentication. Anonymous /dashboard, /oversight and other authenticated product routes redirect even with crawler User-Agent.
states: Known lowercased social/search tokens are accepted. WhatsApp fetcher must begin whatsapp/<digit>; Mozilla WebView containing WhatsApp remains a human browser and follows login. Missing/unknown User-Agent, missing routed URL and unknown path fail closed. Sessionless permitted request renders children without personalized sidebar/bell; page resolves no church and global published corpus only.
validation: /wikileaks is not /wiki. Proxy overwrites any client routed-URL header with actual pathname and query before layout reads it; x-is-crawler is neither read nor emitted. Invalid/expired cookie is rechecked by session resolution. Metadata and article reads share session-derived church scope. Crawler allowance does not bypass origin checks, action authorization, progress/bookmark/rating writes or private article policy.
failures: Unrecognized fetcher variants lose preview cards safely. UA spoofing is inherent; personal data must be guarded by session-derived corpus and feature authorization, not UA. Diverging proxy/layout allowlists previously broke previews and produced 500s; shared classification and source/integration guards prevent drift. Explicitly decide the supported public global preview contract in v3 rather than hiding it inside authentication middleware.
decision: Preserve global Wiki metadata/link previews and authenticated church/user scope. Acceptance must cover ordinary browser redirect, WhatsApp human versus fetcher, spoofed x-is-crawler/routed URL refusal, known-UA global-only rendering, foreign-tenant article denial and unauthenticated writes refusal.

title: External schedules and bounded HTTP job ticks
permissions: Shared CRON_SECRET constant-time bearer; never trigger during audit; Actions least privilege; production destination literal.

validation: External triggers contain no domain business logic; Actions best-effort scheduling/default branch; cancel concurrent runner; response counts checked. Both job routes fail closed when CRON_SECRET is unset, then compare the exact Bearer scheme/header through one Node crypto helper. Presented and expected UTF-8 values are SHA-256 hashed before timingSafeEqual, with raw lengths checked afterward. Wiki revalidation uses the same equality primitive with its own secret. This helper grants no human/agent tenant capability.
failures: Workflow comments claim all errors safely released but queued crash gap remains NTF-002. Tick budget can starve digest sweeps under sustained dispatch backlog; explicit fairness/SLA needed. Fresh v3 should choose reliable worker scheduler proportional to scale, not inherit Hobby workaround. Retain centralized secret-check correctness when moving transports; helper itself accepts an empty expected secret, so route-level unset-secret refusal is part of the required contract.
decision: Preserve capability; implementation redesign is proposed, no removal approved.
